notes.subject: i stap
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula in 'my righteousness is in it'

notes.subject: שבו / ושבי
notes.rationale: Root שׁוב repeated — 'return... return again' — rhetorical repetition kept with 'kam bek... kam bek gen'

notes.subject: ol pren bilong Job
notes.rationale: Job direct-im ol pren bilong en long olgeta

notes.subject: Kam bek
notes.rationale: Imperative we Job i singautim ol pren bilong en olsem

notes.subject: בה
notes.rationale: 'in it' — i tokim taim kot (צדקי), o i tokim tok bilong Job; mipela holim taim kot

translation: Kam bek, plis, i no ken kamap nogut pasin; na kam bek gen — tsedek bilong mi i stap long en.
